overview: The Deep Warrens are the oldest and most dangerous section of Echo Caverns.
details: Predators carved these tunnels long before resonance anomalies emerged. Now, resonance bleed-through mutates creatures and destabilizes the hive ecosystem.
hooks: Predator migrations surge toward Lower Caverns.
A fungal overgrowth blocks a major tunnel.
Resonance bleed-through mutates a predator pack.
A newly exposed hive chamber reveals ancient Luclin markings.
